mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file ( name, org_name, path, created_at ) VALUES ( #{storedFileName}, #{originalFileName}, #{s3Key}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO file_attachments ( file_id, ref_type, ref_id, attached_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{refType}, #{refId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE file_attachments SET ref_type = #{refType}, ref_id = #{refId}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE file_attachments SET is_deleted = '1' WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT fa.id as id, fa.file_id as fileId, fa.ref_type as refType, fa.ref_id as refId, fa.attached_at as attachedAt, fa.is_deleted as isDeleted, f.name as storedFileName, f.org_name as originalFileName, f.path as s3Key, f.file_extension as fileExtension, f.file_size as fileSize, f.created_at as createdAt FROM file_attachments fa INNER JOIN file f ON fa.file_id = f.id WHERE fa.file_id = #{fileId} AND fa.is_deleted = '0'

SELECT fa.id as id, fa.file_id as fileId, fa.ref_type as refType, fa.ref_id as refId, fa.attached_at as attachedAt, fa.is_deleted as isDeleted, f.name as storedFileName, f.org_name as originalFileName, '' as fileSize, SUBSTRING_INDEX(f.org_name, '.', -1) as fileExtension, f.created_at as createdAt FROM file_attachments fa INNER JOIN file f ON fa.file_id = f.id WHERE fa.ref_type = #{refType} AND fa.ref_id = #{refId} AND fa.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY fa.attached_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE fa, f FROM file_attachments fa INNER JOIN file f ON fa.file_id = f.id WHERE fa.ref_type = 'TEMP_UPLOAD' AND fa.ref_id LIKE CONCAT(#{tempRefId}, '%')
